newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: BOEING, MCDONNELL, CSA JOIN FOR CZECH AERO TENDER.
newsitem.headline: BOEING, MCDONNELL, CSA JOIN FOR CZECH AERO TENDER.

text.p: Boeing Co , McDonnell Douglas and Czech airlines Ceske Aerolinie a.s. said on Thursday they submitted a joint bid in a tender for a 34-40 percent stake in Czech jet maker Aero Vodochody a.s. .

A statement released through a local public relations office said the consortium offered to use Aero facilities to make spare parts for Boeing civilian planes and in assembling components for McDonnell Douglas' F/A 18 supersonic fighters.

"In Aero we see a potential supplier of high-quality modules for both the civilian and military aerospace industry," it quoted McDonnell Czech representative Ben Park as saying in the statement, written in Czech.

Aero is developing a light subsonic fighter, the L-159, to be supplied to the Czech army. The Czech military has signed a letter of intent for the purchase of 72 L-159s, and Hungary has also shown interest.

State-controlled shareholders of the debt-strapped company approved a cut in Aero's basic capital to one million crowns from 962 million and subsequent underwriting of new shares in a financial restructuring plan.

The Czech government has declared it would sell a 34 to 40 percent stake in the troubled company to a financially strong strategic investor for a minimum of 950 million crowns, through an equity expansion. The cabinet must still decide how large the stake will be.
Other parties expressing interest in the Aero tender include British Aerospace plc and Swden's Saab bidding as part of the "Gripen" consortium, and the Czech investment comapny, CIMEX Holding a.s..
Another serious Czech contender, chemical and industrial conglomerate Chemapol Group a.s. reportedly has lost interest in the firm because of its severe financial problems.
The Czech daily Mlada Fronta Dnes reported on Thursday that the government has extended its deadline by another four weeks for bids, originally due on February 24.
Officials at the Industry and Trade Ministry, which is conducting the tender, could not be immediately reached for comment on the report.
